notes.zh: 高斯画质档位保留全部数据，新增独立像素倍率与可关闭的交互降质；停止移动后恢复颜色与清晰度。减少重复着色计算及排序纹理分配，完善帧耗时诊断。兼容 nativeApi 6，无需重装 App。
notes.en: All Gaussian quality presets retain every splat. Independent pixel ratio and optional motion quality restore after movement. Reduce redundant shader work and sort allocations; extend frame timing diagnostics. Native API 6 hot update, no reinstall.
